integrity: All algebraic identities and the uniform spectral inequality are proved; finite enumeration verifies only small examples. Prior algebraic ideal and graph spectral results are credited. No independent scientific review or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The ideal classification requires connected symmetric support graphs; the quantitative expander construction is a twofold independent-twin blowup. A Cheeger lower bound assumes an existing regular expander family. The finite-field formula counts ordinary ideals; a basic ideal is separately exhibited over F5. Historical equivalent twin constructions remain possible.
title: Twin-blown-up expanders have unbounded quadratic ideal entropy in evolution algebras
